description: This file defines the DoctorView React component, which provides a user interface for doctors to create and sign prescriptions, view prescription history, and connect a Solana wallet. It includes form controls for patient info, medication details, notes, and functionality for signing prescriptions and local storage of signed data.

methods.name: canonicalMessage
methods.description: Prepares the JSON payload and its canonical string for signing, based on current form state.

methods.name: onConnect
methods.description: Connects to a Solana wallet and sets the wallet public key in state.

methods.name: onSign
methods.description: Signs the prescription data, saves it locally, and resets the form.

methods.name: CopyButton
methods.description: A React component that copies specified content to clipboard and shows copy status.
